prompt: Bug report: a site escapes literal colons in a permalink pattern with a backslash, e.g. `[permalinks.page]` with `guides = '/docs\:v2\:beta/:slug/'`. Only the first colon makes it into the generated URLs (`/docs:v2<NUL>beta/the-slug/`); the second one shows up as a stray control character. Find the cause and fix it. Keep the existing tests passing.
